decisions.reason: As a close-to-core handle family that remained visible after launch, it likely meets at least satisfactory aspiration levels and fits the firm's broad established offering, so management would usually retain it unless portfolio overlap becomes a problem.

This single door handle design is still close to the core business and survived the initial launch period, but as a narrower design-led item it is somewhat more exposed to below-aspiration sales or assortment pruning than a larger family.

The electronic access system is a flagship innovation strongly aligned with the firm's stated move toward integrated digital system families, so a large German firm with R&D capabilities and some slack would be inclined to keep supporting it even under short-run uncertainty.
